scripts.widget: pnpm --filter @voicecore/demo build:widget && mkdir -p static/embed && cp ../demo/public/embed/voicecore.js static/embed/
scripts.console: VITE_DEMO=1 VITE_DEMO_GATEWAY=${VOICECORE_GATEWAY:-http://localhost:8080} VITE_DEMO_SITEKEY=${TURNSTILE_SITEKEY:-} pnpm --filter @voicecore/console exec vite build && rm -rf static/console && cp -r ../console/dist-demo static/console
scripts.start: pnpm widget && pnpm console && docusaurus start --port 3000
scripts.build: pnpm widget && pnpm console && docusaurus build
